release_notes:
A66 canonical release plus merged production-audit closure: fail-closed inherited validator; per-position protection health lease; break-even/profit-lock stop continuity; TP1 recovery scope; prioritized protection market-data requests; per-symbol ticker freshness; truthful order-read state; SQLite Telegram at-least-once outbox; TP1 full-close vs partial-realized net metrics; strict measured-cost validation; economic-model fingerprint and BH-FDR Edge contract; invalid-candle/gap/timeout safety. Existing engines and hard gates are retained. Offline verification only; profitability and live venue integration are not certified. A67 adds a read-only Opportunity Hunter over existing market snapshots and the existing 18-engine/canonical pipeline: WATCH, CONFIRMED, TRADEABLE (PRESEND_PASS only; not order/fill), INVALIDATED and EXPIRED; four closed-candle pattern lanes; SQLite persistence; rate-limited Telegram alerts; no extra exchange reads, no order authority, no gate relaxation. Profitability and live venue integration remain unverified. Post-A69 audit: SizingEngine now rejects non-finite price geometry before balance access; no entry authority or hard thresholds were relaxed.; A70 moved the final audit identity closure before CLI and persistent entrypoint, added an A70 runtime/package identity and order regression; no strategy or live authority change. A72 separates unauthenticated public MEXC Spot discovery from optional private account reconciliation, skips private balance preflight in monitor-only mode, and reports descriptive BTC macro before empty-Universe defer; no live authority or strategy gates were relaxed.

A73 confirmed-only opportunity alerts: WATCH remains internal; PREQUAL_PASS is not enough to notify; CONFIRMED requires closed-bar technical confirmation or canonical SCORE_PASS; TRADEABLE requires PRESEND_PASS. Hunter messages include MEXC Spot TradingView links. Existing Swing candidates deduplicate on a closed-bar anchor, use a 7-day default lifetime and are tracked on closed 1h bars; intraday ideas remain on closed 5m bars. All TP/SL outcomes remain shadow reference touches, never fills or realized PnL.

A73: 7 confirmed issues corrected: 6 runtime/logic defects plus 1 stale .env.example credentials statement; 10 existing files modified; none added/deleted. WATCH is internal only; confirmed alerts require closed-bar technical confirmation or canonical SCORE_PASS; TradingView link added; SWING observation uses 1h closes and a seven-day default TTL; outcomes remain reference-only.

A73 confirmed-only opportunity alerts: WATCH remains internal; PREQUAL_PASS is not enough to notify; CONFIRMED requires closed-bar technical confirmation or canonical SCORE_PASS; TRADEABLE requires PRESEND_PASS. Hunter messages include MEXC Spot TradingView links. Existing Swing candidates deduplicate on a closed-bar anchor, use a 7-day default lifetime and are tracked on closed 1h bars; intraday ideas remain on closed 5m bars. TP/SL outcomes remain reference-only, never fills or realized PnL.
remaining_unverified_or_deferred: Railway Service Start Command, environment variables, persistent Volume mount, healthcheck settings, memory quota and exit reason are host-side settings and cannot be changed or verified from this archive.
The read-only monitor now uses an unauthenticated public MEXC client; private credentials remain unverified/optional for recovered position or unresolved-order reconciliation and protection only.

Pending counterfactual samples are retained, but no separate scheduler was added to fetch/resolve symbols that are no longer present in the active market_data_map. Such rows remain pending rather than receiving fabricated outcomes.
A full transitive hash lock was not fabricated or regenerated; requirements-lock.txt remains a direct-pin seed and the Docker build was not run in the target Linux amd64 environment.
The monolithic main.py was not split into modules in this corrective pass; startup source parsing was bounded to callable spans instead.
Telegram delivery remains at-least-once; real delivery acknowledgements and restart-durable semantic callbacks were not verified.
Static-analysis warnings were not bulk-edited: only reproduced defects with a clear active-path impact were corrected; legacy/dead-code warnings need separate provenance review.
